business: ChefJiw.ai (Chef Jiw, an AI Thai cooking coach for people abroad)
target: Adults 25 to 45 living outside Thailand who love Thai food, order it often, and want to cook it at home
where: Online, mainly US, UK, Australia and Europe

segments.name: Young professional who cooks to save money
Thai diaspora or partner of a Thai person

behaviours.name: Free-content user
behaviours.how: Learns from YouTube, TikTok and recipe blogs and never pays for recipes.

behaviours.name: Already pays for a cooking or meal app
behaviours.how: Has a subscription like a recipe app or meal kit and is open to another if it earns its place.

behaviours.name: Asks a general AI chatbot
behaviours.how: Already asks a free AI chatbot for recipes and substitutions.

behaviours.name: Authenticity seeker
behaviours.how: Wants the real version, cares where the recipe comes from and who teaches it.

behaviours.name: Busy weeknight cook
behaviours.how: Cooks fast dinners after work and gives up if a recipe needs hard-to-find ingredients.

behaviours.name: Tries apps then churns
behaviours.how: Downloads new apps eagerly, uses them for a week, then forgets them.

objections: I can find Thai recipes free on YouTube
A free AI chatbot already does this
I can't find the Thai ingredients where I live
Will an AI actually know authentic Thai cooking?
Talking to an app while cooking feels awkward
I don't cook Thai often enough to subscribe
habits: you order Thai takeaway at least twice a month
your nearest Asian grocery is a 30-minute drive away
you cook dinner most weeknights with your phone propped on the counter
you visited Thailand once and still talk about the food
you save recipe videos you never actually make
